en: The Eighth Method: Exposition of the Terms for the Dissociated and the Associated.
With which aggregates, bases, and elements are those phenomena associated that are dissociated from the aggregate of material form?
None. With which aggregates, bases, and elements are those phenomena associated that are dissociated from the aggregate of feeling? ...

Those phenomena that are included in the aggregate of perception … those phenomena that are included in the aggregate of volitional formations … those phenomena that are included in the aggregate of consciousness … [and so forth] …

Regarding those states that are dissociated from states with conflict (*saraṇa*) and those states that are dissociated from states without conflict (*araṇa*): with how many aggregates, with how many bases, and with how many elements are those states associated?
The sense-sphere of mental phenomena is the element of mental phenomena;
then there is vitality and name-and-form;
the sixfold sense base, birth, aging, and death.
And two triads are not obtained.
In the first interval there are seven,
and ten in the final group at the end.
Fourteen and six at the head—
these forty-seven factors are not found in the stage of complete eradication.
And [the section] "by way of a foolish question.
This concludes the eighth exposition: the indication of associated and dissociated states.
